latest_direction: Low-poly Apollo. The bottom-right floating character is shelved. Mascot remains in branding, onboarding, and select guided moments.

prompts.name: 01 — Soft facet
prompts.detail: STYLE A: Premium low-poly character. Deliberate broad rounded polygonal facets clearly visible on apple hood, limbs and body, approximately a few hundred softly beveled planes, like a contemporary designer toy rendered in satin molded resin. The faces are gently angled, not perfectly smooth; sophisticated low-poly sculptural geometry and clean silhouette. Mostly matte/satin coral with restrained soft-edged specular light. The cream face is gently faceted too, button nose a tiny rounded faceted bead. Make it visibly different from a smooth cartoon: the faceting is the design feature, but still adorable.
prompts.prompt:
Create a polished 3D full-body mascot design for Apollo, a coral health app. The attached sketch is the character reference, the second reference is the coral color. The character is a tiny cute person wearing an apple costume, NOT simply a fruit with a face. Keep an unmistakable oversized apple-shaped hood/hat with two apple lobes, small brown stem and one sage leaf; a cream oval face inside the hood; tiny dark dot eyes, a small cute round protruding BUTTON NOSE, subtle blush cheeks, gentle happy smile; plump short body in coral onesie, stubby legs and rounded mitten hands. One hand raised in a friendly wave. Main coral #EF7B6B, warm ivory #FFF2E4, sage leaf, cocoa facial details. Only ONE character, front three-quarter view, centered with whole body including stem and feet visible and useful margin, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. Beautiful physically based 3D render with sculptural depth and sophisticated studio lighting, soft ambient occlusion. Absolutely NO fuzz, fur, hair, fibers, cloth texture, illustration, clipart, flat graphic shapes, outlines, text, lettering, additional props or floor.

prompts.name: 02 — Muse-inspired companion
prompts.detail: STYLE B: Muse/Jolly-inspired emotional warmth and friendly companion proportions, reinterpreted as this original apple-suit character, with NO fur or textile. Extremely smooth rounded inflated forms, generous apple hood around a squishy cream face, small warm brown bead eyes, very cute little coral rounded button nose, shy smile and blush. Smooth soft-touch matte vinyl / silicone with subtle subsurface scattering and polished professional 3D rendering. Body more bean shaped, arms cuddly and simple, wave open and welcoming. Feels alive, gentle, warm, approachable, not mechanical or hyper glossy. Premium animated-film character design.

prompts.name: 03 — Grokbot-inspired Orbit
prompts.detail: STYLE C: Grokbot-inspired tiny friendly robot vibe, adapted to an original coral apple-suit mascot. Compact futuristic designer robot with a smooth polished coral apple helmet, subtle molded seam, luminous warm-ivory oval face display (NOT a black scary screen), two expressive dark vertical oval LED-like eyes, a small physically protruding coral button nose and a tiny happy smile. Short rounded robotic capsule arms and legs with subtle ball joints, a small floating-friendly stance. High-gloss enamel with crisp controlled reflections, softly luminous face, futuristic minimalism. Friendly healthcare companion, not armor, no weapons, no exposed electronics, no brand logos. Apple stem and sage leaf remain. Mechanically precise, small, appealing.

prompts.name: 04 — Ceramic keepsake
prompts.detail: STYLE D: Sophisticated collectible ceramic art toy. Broad polished glossy glazed coral apple hood with ceramic highlights, a creamy porcelain oval face, a cute small round warm-peach button nose, little dark cocoa inset eyes, quiet simple smile, tiny peach cheek blush. A compact pear-shaped satin-ceramic coral body with soft sculpted mitten arms, one lifted in a relaxed wave, tiny separated feet. Sage leaf looks like a little glazed ceramic leaf. More sculptural and charming than a robot, a lovely high-end collectible object. Subtle warm ceramic translucency at edges, pearlescent studio reflections, clean sophisticated product render, restrained materials, no chrome.
